title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft HCM → PayrollResult

source_objects.description: Earnings detail: EMPLID, PAY_END_DT, ERNCD (earnings code), OTH_HRS, OTH_EARNS, REG_HRS, REG_EARNS, OT_HRS, OT_EARNS.
Deduction detail: EMPLID, PAY_END_DT, DEDCD (deduction code), DED_CUR (current period deduction amount), DED_YTD.
Tax detail: EMPLID, PAY_END_DT, STATE, TAX_CLASS (WT=withholding, SS=social security, MD=medicare), TAX_CUR, TAX_YTD.
Pay check summary: EMPLID, PAY_END_DT, CHECK_DT, TOTAL_GROSS, TOTAL_TAXES, TOTAL_DEDUCTIONS, NET_PAY, PAYGROUP.
Pay distribution (labor allocation): EMPLID, ERNCD, DEPTID, FUND_CODE, ACCOUNT, PROJECT_ID, MONETARY_AMOUNT. Where the labor cost is charged.
Earnings code decode: ERNCD, DESCR (Regular, Overtime, Shift Diff, etc.).
Deduction code decode: DEDCD, DESCR (Federal Tax, Medical, 403b, etc.).

attribute_mappings.source: Derived from PAY_END_DT - pay period length (from PAYGROUP setup)
attribute_mappings.transformation: Cast to ISO 8601. PS stores PAY_END_DT; start date derived from pay group frequency.
Cast to ISO 8601. The actual payment date.

attribute_mappings.source: PS_PAY_EARNINGS where ERNCD = 'REG' sum of REG_EARNS
PS_PAY_EARNINGS where ERNCD = 'OTP' sum of OT_EARNS
Sum of PS_PAY_EARNINGS where ERNCD not in ('REG','OTP')
PS_PAY_DEDUCTION where DEDCD in retirement codes
Sum of PS_PAY_DEDUCTION where DEDCD in benefit codes
attribute_mappings.transformation: Medical + dental + vision + life premium deductions.
If labor charged to a grant.

notes: PS Payroll stores results at the earnings/deduction/tax detail level — summarize up to PS_PAY_CHECK for the statement view. Labor distribution (PS_PAY_DIST) shows where the cost hits the GL. Higher-ed complexity: 9-month faculty pay distributed over 12 months, GA stipends with tuition remission, multi-fund labor splits (50% operating + 50% grant).
